sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Terminology 30

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Terminology 30:1
items.html: The act of creation is the phase of ZAT, whose essence is HGT NH, for there are no more than five Hassadim, HGT NH. Yesod is not a measure in its own right, but a phase that includes the five Hassadim together, and likewise Malchut is a second inclusive one, as above in the words of the ARI (Page 249, Item 8). Therefore they are only five Sefirot, HGT NH. When they are from Abba, they are discerned as five lights, which is the secret of the five times “light” mentioned in the act of creation. When they are from Ima, they are the five times “water” mentioned in the act of creation. And when they are from ZA, this is the secret of the five firmaments mentioned in the act of creation. The explanation of the matter is that the ascent of the bottom Hey to the Einayim, in the secret of the association of the quality of mercy with judgment, is rooted only in Ima, who is the secret of SAG, since she receives from the phase corresponding to her in SAG of AK. However, Abba, who receives from the phase corresponding to him in AB of AK, no longer has anything of this association, as is known. And you already know that in the first restriction, before this association of the quality of mercy with judgment was made, there was only one vessel in the Partzufim, in the secret of Akudim, so that the first nine Sefirot were all entirely light and only their Malchut was in the phase of a vessel. It is only through the secret of the association of the quality of mercy with judgment that ten vessels came to be in the Partzuf. Therefore the Hesed of Abba is discerned as being entirely light, for it has nothing at all of the second restriction, as above, and hence the five Hassadim of Abba are called by the name “five lights”. However, the five Hassadim of Ima already come from the second restriction, in the secret of the association of the quality of mercy with judgment, and there is already a phase of a vessel even in her first nine Sefirot. Therefore the five Hassadim in her are discerned as the phase of water, meaning that they contain the phase of the coarseness of the vessels and are not merely the phase of refined light without any phase of vessels, like the five Hassadim of Abba. For this reason it is only in Ima that the secret of the firmament dividing between water and water is made. For this firmament is the secret of the Parsa that was spread beneath Hochma, by force of Hochma having been corrected in herself in the manner of male and female, owing to the ascent of the bottom Hey to the Einayim, which are the secret of Hochma. For this imprint of the bottom Hey spread out like a Parsa and brought Bina and ZON outside of its degree, in the secret of the lower water, as is known. And this correction of the firmament that divides between the upper water, which is GE, and the lower water, which is AHP, is made only in the lower third of the Tifferet of Ima, which receives from the phase corresponding to it in SAG of AK, where the GAR of Nekudim stand, from the place of the Tabur of SAG of AK to the Sium of her Tifferet, as is known. That is why this place is called by the name “belly”, as above in answer 13.
